speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms, such as fever and headache, first began?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, or decreased fetal movement? Also, have you consumed any unpasteurized dairy products or soft cheeses recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your consumption of ice cream and these flu-like symptoms, I suspect Listeriosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, REQUEST TEST: Listeria_Serology

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Blood Culture: Positive for Gram-positive rods, catalase-positive, with tumbling motility.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture results are diagnostic for *Listeria monocytogenes*, confirming acute listeriosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Listeriosis
